tours.rawDescription: The Grand Egyptian Museum and Giza Pyramids in a small group of 6 at most, from Sahl Hasheesh: a Sphinx stop, an Egyptologist guide and lunch in Cairo.

tours.rawDescription: Tired from sun and excursions? El Gouna guests unwind in the Royal Turkish hammam: peeling, foam bath, salt cave and jacuzzi, then a 45-minute massage.

tours.sourceName: Grand Aquarium Ticket with Hotel Transfer – Makadi Bay

tours.rawDescription: Full day at Makadi Water World from Hurghada: more than 50 slides and attractions, wave pools, lazy rivers, kids' areas, lunch, drinks and transfers.

tours.sourceName: Private Glass Bottom Boat & Snorkeling – Makadi Bay
tours.cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before start
tours.rawDescription: Just your group, up to 8 people: a private glass bottom boat for Makadi Bay families, 3 hours watching fish below the floor and a short snorkel.

tours.sourceName: Nefertari Pharaonic Cruise with Snorkeling – Soma Bay
tours.cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before start
tours.rawDescription: No need to go as far as Hurghada: the Nefertari Pharaonic cruise sails from Makadi Bay, north of Soma Bay, with an underwater deck and a snorkel.

tours.sourceName: Hula Hula Island Snorkeling Trip – El Gouna

tours.rawDescription: Hula Hula Island suits families and couples from El Gouna: guided snorkeling at two reefs, a buffet lunch, soft drinks and the drive to Hurghada.

tours.sourceName: Grand Egyptian Museum & Pyramids by Limousine – Safaga

tours.sourceName: Luxor Valley of the Queens Day Trip – El Gouna
tours.cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before start
tours.rawDescription: A Luxor day trip from El Gouna for fans of Egypt's royal women: tombs in the Valley of the Queens, Hatshepsut's temple, mighty Karnak and the Colossi.

tours.sourceName: Cairo Pyramids & Egyptian Museum Mini Group – El Gouna
tours.cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before start
tours.rawDescription: Pyramids in a small group: no more than 6 El Gouna guests share the minivan to Giza, the Sphinx and the Egyptian Museum, with an Egyptologist and lunch.

tours.sourceName: Private Speed Boat to Hula Hula Island – Soma Bay
tours.cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before start
tours.rawDescription: Hula Hula Island by private speed boat from Soma Bay: a coral reef snorkeling stop, free time on white sand, your own captain and hotel pickup.

tours.sourceName: Dolphin & Walrus Show at Dolphin World – Makadi Bay

tours.sourceName: Dolphin Show & Swimming with Dolphins – Soma Bay

tours.rawDescription: Swim with dolphins at Dolphin World in Hurghada after a live show, with trainers, the entrance ticket and pickup from your hotel in Soma Bay.

tours.sourceName: Private Speed Boat to Orange Bay – Safaga

tours.sourceName: Alexandria Private Day Tour with Egyptologist Guide – El Alamein

tours.sourceName: Ozirea Island Boat Trip – Soma Bay

tours.rawDescription: Sun loungers, a guided snorkel and an optional infinity pool: the Ozirea Island boat trip for Soma Bay guests, with the drive to the boat in Hurghada.

tours.sourceName: Mega Desert Safari: Quad, Buggy, Jeep & Camel – Hurghada

tours.sourceName: Luxor Valley of the Queens Mini Group – El Gouna

tours.rawDescription: Who were Egypt's queens? Find out in Luxor with 6 guests at most from El Gouna: the Valley of the Queens, Karnak, Hatshepsut and the Colossi of Memnon.

tours.sourceName: Orange Bay Island Snorkeling Trip – Sahl Hasheesh
